nodes.title: Kati Bias-Cut Slip Dress – Matyó Floral
nodes.description: A bias-cut slip dress in silk viscose with adjustable straps and a low back. Named for the founder's grandmother, Kati, the artist behind the prints, and printed in her Matyó Floral, inspired by Hungarian folk embroidery.

nodes.title: Jessie Bias-Cut Slip Dress – Twilight Plumes
nodes.description: A bias-cut slip dress in silk viscose with adjustable straps and a low back, printed in Twilight Plumes from Kati's hand-painted archive. A vintage-inspired printed slip dress that goes from day to evening. Named for Jessie, the founder's childhood friend.

nodes.title: Bodie Silk-Cotton Square Scarf – Twilight Plumes
nodes.description: A large 26 x 26 in square scarf in silk-cotton voile, printed in Twilight Plumes from Kati's archive. Light enough to float and substantial enough to hold a knot — wear it in your hair, at the neck or tied on a bag. Monogrammable, and a thoughtful gift.

nodes.title: Goldie Cotton Bandana – Matyó Floral
nodes.description: An oversized 26 x 26 in bandana in soft cotton voile, printed in Matyó Floral from Kati's 1960s–70s archive. Wear it as a hair scarf, neck scarf or bag charm. Add a chainstitch monogram for a personal gift under $50.

nodes.title: Chainstitch Monogram
nodes.description: Chainstitch embroidery monogram add-on. Personalization details are attached to the order.

nodes.title: Margit One-Piece Swimsuit
nodes.description: A retro-print one-piece swimsuit with a high French-cut leg, adjustable spaghetti straps and full lining, made in recycled nylon. Comes in five prints from Kati's archive of hand-painted designs: Dahlia Seed, Moon Illusion, Good Vibrations, Pastel Asterisk and Orange Asterisk.

nodes.title: Zadie Organic Linen Sundress
nodes.description: A lightweight printed sundress in organic linen with fully adjustable tie-back straps. Unlined but not sheer. Comes in Wildflowers, Candied Plaid or Cherry Coupe. An easy summer and travel dress that can be personalized with a hand-chainstitched monogram.

nodes.title: Esther Maxi Kaftan Dress
nodes.description: A floor-length kaftan dress in matte viscose with a silky lining. Wide butterfly sleeves attached at the side seam, a deep V-neck with hook-and-eye closure, self-fabric waist sash and side slits to the knee. Printed in 1970s-inspired patterns from Kati's archive: Good Vibrations, Dahlia Seed and Magnolia. Designed to wear on a night out, as a statement hostess dress, or thrown over a swimsuit to lounge by the pool.

nodes.title: Vera Printed Car Coat
nodes.description: An oversized printed car coat with dropped shoulders, a 1930s menswear-inspired shawl collar, Western-style back yoke detailing, deep slash pockets and a single-button closure. Brushed cotton twill, fully lined in silky viscose. Printed in Matyó Floral, inspired by Hungarian folk embroidery, or Midnight Plumes — both from Kati's archive of hand-painted textile designs. A statement fall coat that layers over everything. Note: this style is meant to fit unstructured and a bit oversized; it does not have shoulder pads.

nodes.title: Arielle Silk Slip Dress
nodes.description: Introducing a new print from the archive: Parlor Rose, adapted from a 1960s–70s hand-painted design by our founder's grandmother, Kati, in two gorgeous colorways for autumn — terracotta and olive. The perfect layering piece for fall. 100% silk slip dress with squared off neckline, low V-back and adjustable spaghetti straps. Unlined. Please allow 3 weeks for shipping as this item will be made to order.
